Name: Clint Sells More (Cinder Shards and Prismatic Shards Plus More)
Author: GingerNinja7921
Description:
Requirements: Content Patcher: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915
                          Shop Tile Framework (STF): https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005

Mod Title: Clint's Expanded Shop


Description: In the "Clint's Expanded Shop" mod for Stardew Valley, Clint's blacksmith shop is getting a major upgrade! Say goodbye to the limited selection of ores and tools because now Clint has decided to expand his inventory to offer more enticing items.


Features:
[list=1]
[*]Cinder Shards: Want to add a fiery touch to your tools or just want to impress the townsfolk? Clint now sells cinder shards, a rare and valuable material, perfect for upgrading your tools or crafting unique decorations.

[*]Prismatic Shards: Unlock the magic of the valley with prismatic shards, now available at Clint's shop. These coveted gems are not just for the Museum anymore; you can use them to enhance your farm life.

[*]More to Come: But that's not all! We've got big plans for Clint's shop. This mod is a work in progress, and we're actively taking input from players like you to expand the selection further. Have an idea for an item you'd like to see in Clint's inventory? Share it with us, and you might just see it in the next update.

[/list]Customization and Collaboration: I believe in community-driven modding, so I encourage you to collaborate with others and share your suggestions. Whether it's new ores, tools, or decorations to add to Clint's shop, your feedback can shape the future of Clint's shop.
Elevate your Stardew Valley experience with "Clint's Expanded Shop" mod. Download it now and keep an eye out for exciting updates as we continue to expand Clint's inventory based on your input. Your farm will never be the same again!

Compatibility: So far in mods I've tested it works fine with no problems whatsoever, however, i really reccomend installing "Clint Shop Overhaul": https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10529
